Name: Little Mage Jas - English Translation - Magic Jas
Author: MaryOliver28
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]This mod adds a new dialogue for the npc Jas, and gives her magic powers! Jas is now very polite and will give you lots of gifts, all made by her using her spells! But she keeps her powers a secret, and will only tell you, the farmer, to help you![/size]

[u][color=#9900ff][size=4]Requires content patcher.[/size][/color][/u]


[size=5]Original mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114622928]luoli1119[/url], go and endorse her mod, it makes the autor happy <3[/size]

The link to the original Chinese mod is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10796?tab=description&BH=0]here[/url].

This is my very first translation, and since I don't speak Chinese, google translator helped me A LOT, so please tell me with there is any mistakes in my translation (I am also not a english native speaker, but I did my best).

Thank you :)[/font]
